patch_description: The current greedy heuristic picks the GPU with the lowest KVPR *before* placing the model, ignoring the model's own contribution. Instead, evaluate each candidate GPU's KVPR *after* hypothetically placing the model on it, i.e., (w_j + r/s) / (mem - size_j), and pick the GPU that minimizes the resulting KVPR. This directly targets the objective (minimizing max KVPR) and avoids dumping a large model onto a GPU where it dramatically raises pressure. A tie-break on remaining memory helps future placements fit.
